name: CropCore — AI Agricultural Intelligence Platform
description: CropCore is an AI-powered smart farming assistant developed during Pitchathon 2024 by Team Cache Me. It equips farmers with technology by offering real-time sensor data (temperature, humidity, moisture, NPK), live market price tracking, AI-powered weed detection (YOLOv8), advanced disease detection (CNN), automated smart irrigation, and a community platform. The solution is designed to boost agricultural productivity and profitability by making modern technology accessible to farmers. The system has been patented under the Indian Patent Office (Application No: 202541067987).

name: CareerTrack — AI Career Intelligence Platform
description: CareerTrack is a full-stack AI career coaching system that ingests a user's resume, GitHub profile, and job description to generate personalized gap analysis, mock interview question banks, and ATS-optimized resume rewrites. Features a LangChain multi-agent orchestration layer for specialized subagents (resume agent, interview agent, portfolio agent). React frontend with FastAPI backend. Designed for students and early-career engineers.

name: KRED — AI-powered Financial Intelligence Platform
description: KRED is an AI-powered life and financial intelligence engine designed to tackle retirement blindness among Gen Z. Instead of just tracking expenses, it analyzes user behavior and converts everyday decisions into future financial and life outcomes, helping users clearly see the long-term impact of their present actions. Built during Vashisht Hackathon 3.0 — a 36-hour national-level hackathon hosted by IIITDM Kancheepuram — the team Perry the Platypus secured the FinTech track win. Key features include: AI Behavioural Analysis Engine, Life Regret Intelligence (quantifying the long-term cost of daily habits using compounding), Micro Life Simulation, Future Life Projection, Dynamic Spending Limits, Retirement Intelligence Engine, KRED Reels (short-form personalized financial insights), and an AI Financial Assistant. The project bridges the gap between knowing and acting by making the future visible and actionable today.
achievements: 1st Place — FinTech Track, Vashisht Hackathon 3.0 (IIITDM Kancheepuram)
